title: Effect of class proportion shifts on classifier curvature
abstract: arXiv:2611.34702v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Changing the class mix can alter mean loss without changing the classifier. To distinguish this reweighting from changes in the model itself, we studied ten-class CIFAR-10 classification in separate branches for two target classes, measuring the trace of the loss Hessian with respect to the output-layer parameters on fixed images of each target class. Across ten new initialisations, after 60 updates to the output layer with frozen features, the trace changed by -0.152% on average in branches where the target class share rose from 10% to 19%, and by +0.071% in branches where it fell to 1%, relative to each branch's initial trace. These changes do not isolate the effect of class share from that of the assigned training images. We developed a forecast based on initial class gradients after examining the first experiment's results and then tested it prospectively without modification. translated_title: 类别比例变化对分类器曲率的影响
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.34702v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：改变类别混合比例可以在不改变分类器的情况下改变平均损失。为了将这种重新加权效应与模型本身的变化区分开来，我们研究了十类CIFAR-10分类任务，为两个目标类别分别设置独立分支，并在每个目标类别的固定图像上测量损失Hessian矩阵相对于输出层参数的迹。在十次新的初始化实验中，在特征冻结的条件下对输出层进行60次更新后，相对于各分支的初始迹，在目标类别比例从10%上升到19%的分支中，迹平均变化了-0.152%；而在比例下降到1%的分支中，迹变化了+0.071%。这些变化无法将类别比例的影响与所分配训练图像的影响分离开来。我们在检查第一次实验结果后，开发了一种基于初始类别梯度的预测方法，然后在不做任何修改的情况下进行了前瞻性测试。对于从10%直接增加到19%的情况，而不是增加……
tldr: 该论文通过测量输出层参数的损失Hessian迹来研究类别比例变化对分类器曲率的影响，发现曲率变化极小（-0.152%至+0.071%），并提出了一种基于初始类别梯度的预测方法且通过了前瞻性验证。
en_tdlr: This paper studies how class proportion shifts affect classifier curvature by measuring the trace of the loss Hessian with respect to output-layer parameters, finding minimal curvature changes (-0.152% to +0.071%) and proposing a forecast based on initial class gradients that was prospectively validated.
